hooks.command:
ROOT="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)}"
MDLLM="$ROOT/"'./tools/mdllm.py'
FW="${MDLLM%/*/*}"
PY=""
PY_PREFIX=""
MDLLM_LAUNCH_DEADLINE=""
MDLLM_DATE=""
MDLLM_TIMEOUT=""
if [ -x /usr/bin/date ] && [ -x /usr/bin/timeout ]; then
  MDLLM_DATE=/usr/bin/date
  MDLLM_TIMEOUT=/usr/bin/timeout
elif timeout --version >/dev/null 2>&1 && date +%s >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  MDLLM_DATE=date
  MDLLM_TIMEOUT=timeout
fi
if [ -n "$MDLLM_DATE" ] && [ -n "$MDLLM_TIMEOUT" ]; then
  MDLLM_LAUNCH_DEADLINE=$(( $("$MDLLM_DATE" +%s) + 10 ))
fi
mdllm_probe() {
  [ -n "$MDLLM_LAUNCH_DEADLINE" ] || return 1
  mdllm_remaining=$(( MDLLM_LAUNCH_DEADLINE - $("$MDLLM_DATE" +%s) ))
  [ "$mdllm_remaining" -gt 0 ] || return 1
  "$MDLLM_TIMEOUT" "$mdllm_remaining" "$@" -c "import yaml" >/dev/null 2>&1
}
MDLLM_WINDOWS_SH="${MSYSTEM:-}"
if [ -z "$PY" ] && mdllm_probe "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"; then
  PY="$ROOT/.venv/bin/python"
fi
if [ -z "$PY" ] && [ -n "$MDLLM_WINDOWS_SH" ] && mdllm_probe "$ROOT/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; then
  PY="$ROOT/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"
fi
if [ -z "$PY" ] && mdllm_probe "$FW/.venv/bin/python"; then
  PY="$FW/.venv/bin/python"
fi
if [ -z "$PY" ] && [ -n "$MDLLM_WINDOWS_SH" ] && mdllm_probe "$FW/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; then
  PY="$FW/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"
fi
if [ -z "$PY" ] && mdllm_probe python3; then
  PY="python3"
fi
if [ -z "$PY" ] && mdllm_probe python; then
  PY="python"
fi
if [ -z "$PY" ] && [ -n "$MDLLM_WINDOWS_SH" ] && mdllm_probe py "-3"; then
  PY="py"
  PY_PREFIX="-3"
fi
mdllm_python() {
  if [ -n "$PY_PREFIX" ]; then
    "$PY" "$PY_PREFIX" "$@"
  else
    "$PY" "$@"
  fi
}
if [ -z "$PY" ] || [ ! -f "$MDLLM" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"MarkdownLLM session-start could not run: no floor-capable Python or mdllm.py was found."}}'
else
  mdllm_python "$MDLLM" harness-event claude-code session-start "$ROOT" 'sha256:f3f23bf371eab27620c24166734c287ff4f4b750d03378a9c6abf8a4986f17cc'
fi
exit 0
